causal_chains.chain: Actual C05 and independently admitted recipient -> live domain change -> preserved reply -> exact ref negative -> work/unconfirmed -> actual HTTP observation -> exact displayed token confirm and idempotent retry -> source/domain invariants -> C16 refusal -> actual SQLite close/reopen and fresh consumers -> same saved baseline/work state and denied old in-memory observation.

New actual C05/recipient/domain-change/reply -> actual prepare + human confirm via C08 -> actual SQLite reopen and fresh consumers -> edit same message/incarnation/version -> exactly one stale item and repeated projection -> old observation denied -> new answerRef/prepare/confirm -> work suppression -> original version/body/pin -> same thread resolve and edited answer reuse.

New actual C05/recipient/domain-change/reply -> actual prepare/human confirm -> new current-source question/reply with exactly same body -> unconfirmed status/shared current answer -> current review ACL revoke -> read/prepare/work all non-ok with no body or pin. The body alias edit.body is only a same-text selector in this scenario, not a claim that the edit journey was skipped or proven here.

Original second test unchanged: revoke review ACL during final human reply await -> no commit -> restore real admission/reply -> observe -> revoke at confirmation C08 commit -> no commit -> restore + explicit new observation/idempotency key -> confirm/read -> legal delete then hostile storage replacement -> new defined physical incarnation and old response denied.

r10_additional_oracles.real_causal_chain: Real C05 preserve and recipient admission -> actual question/reply -> prepare and human confirmation -> capture canonical thread/baseline -> intercept completed real C08 read outside the transaction -> separately admitted actual human edit -> return captured external read -> refuse old confirmed/valid output -> prove one version increment, same baseline/source physical identity/review/ACL, and current stale Work.
r10_additional_oracles.discriminant: read intercepts its second baseline read; Work intercepts its own second thread/answer/baseline read. No outer Work collection or fabricated source/baseline can hide an old component success.
